m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Yeah, well, I wish there was time to celebrate, but the Chaos Heart is free from all its bindings now. We better hur- uuugh. Oh no.
He's here. My father is here! I can feel it. We have to get the Chaos Heart before he does!
We did it! It will take a while for this vortex to die down, but the Storm Titan has been dispelled!
Is everyone alright? Wizard? Mellori! Are you OK?!?
I mean, this is usually where Bat lays out some grandiose, so-crazy-it-just-might-work plan, right?
The Titanic Lullaby has clearly weakened the Storm Titan, but he's still receiving jolts of Storm Energy from the Paradox Chain.
We must brave his turbulent wake and force the Storm Titan to release his grip from the Paradox Chain.
We'll cross that bridge when we get there... Together. Let's storm this Titan!
Oof, OK I trust you, Bat. Just promise you'll stop trying to make jokes.
The Paradox Chain is keeping the Storm Titan awake and enraged. We have to release his grip! Let's go!
